column1: # The stoplist of the example sentences (docs/specs/0134-example-sentences.md, "Offensive sentences").
# A sentence or translation with a word on it is never stored. Read by Scripts/build_examples.py.
# Columns: lang (ISO 639-3), kind, entry (lowercase, NFC), tab-separated.
#   ell seed: the one-word lemmas of the pinned Wiktionary subset whose every sense is tagged vulgar,
#             offensive, derogatory, pejorative or slur; computed by the build, listed in examples-qa.md
#   remove:   drops a seed entry that is not offensive (ell only)
#   lemma:    a Greek or English lemma; every form of it counts (Greek through the forms tables,
#   prefix:   a Russian, Spanish or Arabic word start
# Draft by the developer for Kirill's review in the #177 PR. Not on it on purpose: βιάζω, whose forms are
# also those of βιάζομαι ("I'm in a hurry", a top-500 verb).
